boss.intro: The lobby doors have locked! Solve each clue to find the next one. Every answer is the key to the clue that follows.

steps.q: Clue 1, on the front desk: I have keys but open no doors. I have a space bar but no room. What am I?
Clue 2, typed on the screen: "Look up! On the wall behind the keyboard hangs something with hands but no arms, and it never claps. What is it?"
Clue 3, taped to the back of the clock: "After a swim I hang nearby. What gets wetter the more it dries?"
Clue 4, pinned to the towel: "The power is out, so light me up! I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?"
Final clue, written in wax by the candle light: "The more of me you take, the more of me you leave behind. Follow me to the exit!"
